description: CSS-only animated loading spinner. Standalone: add role="status" + aria-label. Next to visible text: add aria-hidden="true".

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Spinner diameter and stroke: xs 0.75em, s 1em, m 1.5em, l 2.5em, xl 4em (em-relative, so it scales with the surrounding text).

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: Arc colour from a theme token (--color-interactive / -success / -warning / -error). Without it the arc uses currentColor.

attributes.name: data-overlay
attributes.description: position: absolute; inset: 0 over the nearest positioned ancestor, with a translucent surface backdrop and the spinner centered. The container must have a non-static position.

cssProperties.name: --spinner-track
cssProperties.description: Track colour (default the arc colour at 20% alpha).

cssProperties.name: --spinner-speed
cssProperties.description: Duration of one rotation (default 0.7s; 1.5s under reduced motion).
